name: A session can stall in many ways
title: A session can stall in many ways
story: An agent session with a faint live feed sits at the top left. The factory checks it every few seconds. Three groups of detectors appear one at a time and each chip lights as it is named: no output (no events for 5 minutes, no file written in 15 minutes of work, no file changed in 60 tool calls), going in circles (the same call 4 times, the same command failing the same way 3 times, a file flipping back or a fixed check failing again, 15 file changes with no check newly passing) and money and time (60 percent of the budget spent with nothing pushed, a check-in every 45 minutes of agent time, 2 hours of agent time in all). Then a tripped check makes the factory act, each step stronger up to a human; 2 hours of agent time end any session; every stop lands in Needs you with a question.
